newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Manila SEC asks 5 firms to explain surge in stocks.
newsitem.headline: Manila SEC asks 5 firms to explain surge in stocks.

text.p: The Philippine Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC) said on Thursday it had summoned officials of five listed companies to explain a surge in their stock prices since the start of the year.
SEC chairman Perfecto Yasay told reporters show-cause notices had been sent to Itogon-Suyoc Mines Inc, Atok Big Wedge Co Inc, Pacifica Inc, Acoje Holdings Inc and Marsteel Consolidated Inc.
The officials will be asked if they know of "any information that could have caused the unusual fluctuation (in their stock) prices," he said.
Yasay did not say when the officials of the five firms were ordered to appear before the SEC.

The five companies have repeatedly denied knowledge to the Philippine Stock Exchange of any "material information" that could have affected the price surge in their stocks other than what they have disclosed previously.
